requestedText: Disable automatic redirects on the reusable Weekly Radar source HTTP agent while preserving status, timeout, and body-size behavior.

evidence: The transport setting changes the existing ureq agent construction only; it adds no dynamic loading or runtime code discovery.
HttpClient, FixtureHttpClient, and UreqHttpClient public method signatures remain unchanged; no external consumer migration is required.
The transport change adds no monitoring, telemetry, scheduler, or delivery integration.
The Contract requires a local redirect regression test and preservation of timeout/body-size behavior.
